question_summary: How should `effectiveness_per_sp` be computed when a skill appears in multiple selected/detected roles?
What is the canonical behavior when detected/specified roles have missing or empty efficacy definitions?
decision_detail: Per-role data threshold with fallback. Roles classified as strong (>=2 scored skills) or weak (<2). Strong roles drive Phase 2 ordering; weak roles appended after, ordered by rank. Plan always generates with warning for weak roles.

question_summary: When unmet prerequisites are pulled in to satisfy a Phase 2/3 skill, what target level should the injected prerequisite use?
decision_detail: Minimum required level, placed in Phase 2 before the dependent skill. Orphan prerequisites train to max(required_level) across all dependents, appear immediately before first dependent within its bucket position, get scoring_bucket 'injected_prerequisite', and have no Phase 3 entry (zero role efficacy).
